recipes.name: Homemade Vanilla Sugar
instructions: Add the sugar to a food processor.
Use a small paring knife to slice the vanilla pod in half lengthwise, but try to not cut all the way through.
Open the vanilla along the newly cut seam and use the back of the knife to scrape out the seeds. Add this to the food processor as well. Reserve the emptied vanilla pod for a later step.
Blend the sugar for about 3 to 4 minutes, or until you achieve a fine, almost powder-like consistency. Pour the vanilla sugar into a jar.
Submerge the reserved, empty pod into the sugar. If the pod doesn't fit into your jar, cut it into smaller pieces.

Store the vanilla sugar at room temperature in a cool and dry place for at least 2 weeks for optimal flavour. Make sure to give the jar or container a shake every few weeks as there is a possibility that the sugar can clump together.

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store at room temperature in a cool and dry place for up to 6 months.
